hero.title: Maskindoktorerna
hero.subtitle: Faster. Better. Forward.
hero.lead: Process optimisation, fault analysis, retrofit, robotics, special-purpose machines and CE marking for existing and new production lines. For factories in Örebro, Värmland and Västmanland counties.

intro.line1: Why buy new machines when you can make the ones you have perform better?
intro.line2: The result: higher OEE, less dependence on staff and higher profit.
intro.quote: "Others see a problem, we see a challenge. And we solve it."

items.title: Tailor-made engineering
items.text:
Every factory is different, so every process gets its own approach. We improve existing machines with technical modifications, instead of expensive replacement or off-the-shelf solutions.

Those upgrades and modifications get more capacity and reliability out of the machines already on your floor.

items.title: Fast ROI
items.text:
We do not do long projects or thick reports. We are known for creative, practical improvements that can be carried out quickly and deliver results straight away.

We do not make problems bigger than they are.

items.title: Personal approach
items.text:
We do not advise from the sidelines. We work in the factory, alongside operators, technicians and managers.

That keeps communication short and gives solutions that fit daily practice. Because your team helps make the changes, the knowledge stays on the shop floor and the result lasts.

symptoms.title: Complaints Maskindoktorerna cures
symptoms.intro: Every factory has complaints now and then: machines that underperform, lines that stop, processes that do not run smoothly. We make the diagnosis and fix the cause for good. Typical reasons to call us in:
symptoms.quote: "Stubborn machine? Perfect. That is our speciality."

items.title: Inefficient production process
items.text: Your machines run below capacity and output per hour is lower than it should be. At Coca-Cola we optimised the can process, and the new line now runs 30% faster.
items.imageAlt: Automated production line with small empty bottles on a conveyor in a factory.

items.title: High downtime and maintenance costs
items.text: Unexpected breakdowns and high maintenance costs hit profit directly. Every minute of downtime is lost production. At Coca-Cola we achieved 40% fewer breakdowns.
items.imageAlt: Industrial conveyor system with roller tracks, yellow railings and control panels in a factory hall.

items.title: Heavy dependence on staff
items.text: More and more often, the shortage of staff is what holds production back. We make processes smarter and more automated. At a food company, for example, we automated tasks and packaging speed went up by 20%.
items.imageAlt: Technician on the floor next to orange industrial robots.

about.title: About us
about.text:
At Maskindoktorerna it is all about making things run better. Literally.
We are technical problem solvers who improve existing machines and processes with durable modifications. Instead of thick reports or standard solutions, we do practical work that delivers results straight away.

Since 2018 we have been helping factories produce more efficiently and building special-purpose machines. That experience has taught us that many machines do not need replacing. They need the right treatment.
